column1: # Totals of a stream with the message that wasm/wasmplayer.cpp sends to the front end at its end, and the hints that the
# front end shows for it in the report of the last session (System information). Both sides read this file:
# FormatSessionReportMessage() in wasm/session_report.hpp (tests/native/session_report_test.cpp) writes the message, and
# parseSessionReport() and getSessionReportHints() in wasm/platform/diagnostics.js (tests/unit/diagnostics.test.js) read
# it, with the setting 'Reference frame invalidation' off.
# Format, separated by tabs: name, duration in ms, codec, width, height, frame rate, bitrate in kbps, frames, frames lost
# on the network, frames dropped by the TV, video resets, recovery keyframes, FEC repairs, FEC failures, top of the WASM
# heap in MB, size of the WASM memory in MB, growth of the heap in MB, the best 30 s host frame rate in hundredths of
# FPS, the average host processing latency in tenths of a millisecond, the message, the hints (their keys, comma
# Four problems at once: only the three most important hints show, the memory hint is left out
# A host display at 59.94 Hz (or 119.88 Hz) instead of 60 (or 120 Hz): the best 30 s window of the host shows it
# The host needed more than 75 % of the time between two frames to encode them, in a long session without loss
# No hint about the host: a busy host below the limit, a static desktop at half the rate of the stream, and a busy host
# in a short session or on a lossy network
